Content: Business Central and competitor pricing Business Central and Odoo publish a per-user price you can read today, while NetSuite and Sage Intacct generally give you a number only after a sales conversation. The comparison below turns on what each vendor will put in writing. A published price is a starting point, and the limits and implementation columns are where the totals diverge. The table shows how each product charges and where the cost hides. [...] Business Central plan prices per user Read the table for what each tier costs and what it covers. Essentials and Premium differ by function, not by size, while Team Member is a different kind of seat altogether. | Plan | Price per user per month | What it includes | --- | Team Member | $8 | Read access, approvals and light entries such as time and expenses | | Essentials | $80 | Finance, sales, purchasing, inventory and basic warehousing | | Premium | $110 | Everything in Essentials, plus service management and manufacturing | Source: Microsoft Business Central pricing, , checked 2026-10-22. [...] | Users (full / Team Member) | Essentials, full users per year | Premium, full users per year | What Essentials gives up | --- --- | | 10 (8 / 2) | $6,720–$7,680 | $9,600–$10,560 | Manufacturing and service management | | 30 (20 / 10) | $16,800–$19,200 | $24,000–$26,400 | The same, across more people | | 100 (60 / 40) | $50,400–$57,600 | $72,000–$79,200 | The same, plus any shortfall in headroom | At either end of the range, Premium costs $30 more per full user per month. The real question is whether you need what that $30 buys. Eight full seats on Essentials cost at most $7,680 a year. Premium adds about $2,900 to that, so unless you build products or dispatch service technicians, it's money spent on features nobody opens.
